'''kpimenatl Ground Pounding''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[kpimenatl]]
* '''Published:''' 26 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Tosche Station|SE-L-tatooinetoschestation.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Tosche Station
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Tatooine Tosche Station kpimenatl L.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

There is no objective but to overwhelm the ds with destiny and power.

== Strategy ==

The idea of this deck is to overpower your opponent. You set up the characters to were you can draw multiple destiny. I have a lot of high destiny cards in the deck. This way you can hit the characters with the weapons and attrition them like the dickens.
